paper.title: AVES: Animal Vocalization Encoder based on Self-Supervision

official_code.migration_note: The frozen AVES repository points future development to Earth Species Project AVEX. This screen retains the published AVES-base-bio model identity.

checkpoint.pretraining: 153 hours of AVES core data plus animal-labelled subsets from AudioSet and VGGSound, 360 hours total
checkpoint.selection_reason: The official AVES study reports that a smaller task-related pretraining subset can outperform a much larger broad-audio subset; base-bio has the closest prior to feline vocalizations.

output.pooling: arithmetic mean across valid final-layer temporal frames

known_runtime_notes: The official TorchAudio wrapper returns the selected encoder layer as batch by time by 768.
The official AVES classifier applies temporal mean pooling before its downstream head.
Each call is forwarded independently because padded batch inference changes HuBERT frame embeddings.
